Three Simple Steps to Relief—Takes Under 30 Seconds

No complicated routines. No mess. No waiting about. BioEdge™ fits seamlessly into your morning and evening, simply roll, absorb, and continue.

You needn't change your life to use BioEdge™. It works around your schedule, absorbs invisibly, and starts working before you finish getting dressed. Most users apply it whilst their tea brews or just before bed, it's that simple.

1

Apply Directly

Shake bottle gently. Roll directly onto affected areas—feet, hands, or any nerve-discomfort zones. The leakproof roll-on design means no mess, no waste, no greasy fingers.

2

Massage Gently

Use the cooling roller ball to massage in gentle circles for 30-45 seconds. You'll experience immediate soothing relief as circulation increases and magnesium penetrates deeply.

3

Allow Absorption

Allow 2-3 minutes for complete absorption. The non-greasy formula absorbs into skin, leaving only comfort. Apply morning and evening for progressive symptom reduction over 12 weeks.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long before I feel any relief from the burning pain?

    Most users report noticeable reduction in burning, tingling, or shooting pain within 5-15 minutes of application. This immediate relief comes from the menthol activating cooling receptors. However, the deeper nerve healing compounds (St John's Wort, Boswellia) build effectiveness over 2-4 weeks of consistent twice-daily use. Think of it as immediate comfort plus progressive healing.

I'm on Gabapentin/Lyrica. Can I use this with my medication?

    BioEdge™ is topical and works locally at the nerve endings, not systemically. It has zero known drug interactions because it never enters your bloodstream in significant amounts. That said, if you wish to reduce your medications, do so gradually under your doctor's supervision. Many users have successfully reduced or eliminated oral medications after 4-8 weeks of consistent BioEdge™ use.

What if this doesn't work for my type of nerve pain?

    BioEdge™ is formulated for peripheral neuropathy from any cause: diabetic neuropathy, post shingles neuralgia, chemotherapy-induced neuropathy, sciatica, and mechanical nerve compression. It works on the shared mechanisms of nerve pain regardless of origin. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee specifically because we know not every body responds identically.

How much do I apply and how often per day?

    Apply a thin layer to affected areas twice daily, morning and evening. For feet, that's typically 3-4 rolls per foot. For sciatica, apply along the pathway from lower back down the leg. One bottle lasts approximately 30-45 days with typical use. More isn't better; consistent application matters more than quantity.

Does this actually repair nerves or just mask the pain?
